children: Prime Industries raises Rs 11.86 crore from Omega Seika Mobility founder Uday Narang to expand defence, nuclear and precision manufacturing
Prime Industries Ltd has raised Rs 11.86 crore in funding from Dr Uday Narang, founder of Omega Seika Mobility.
The company said the capital will be used to support its growth plans, including the proposed establishment of a research and development and incubation centre for its Special Product Division.
Prime Industries is focusing on defence, nuclear and precision manufacturing through its existing business interests and engineering capabilities.

The company has minority and majority interests in businesses including Kay Bouvet Engineering Ltd and Linga Agri, which operate across specialised engineering, industrial manufacturing and related applications.

Narang is also associated with OBSC Perfection Ltd, a precision manufacturing company with capabilities in CNC machining, investment casting, forging and stamping. The company serves industrial applications including defence and aerospace.

Prime Industries' leadership team includes Deepak Handa, who has more than 25 years of experience in automotive operations, business development and precision manufacturing. He currently serves as Technical Director for Operations and Business Development at Omega Bright Steel.

The latest funding is expected to support Prime Industries' plans to develop specialised product and engineering capabilities, with the proposed R&D and incubation centre forming part of its strategy for the Special Product Division.
